body:
Complete guide to Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. Learn about the best starters, Tera Raid strategies, shiny hunting, and tips for completing your Paldea Pokédex.

Pokémon Scarlet and Violet introduced players to the Paldea region, a sprawling open-world adventure that changed how we experience Pokémon games forever. With 110 new Pokémon, the Terastallize mechanic, and three distinct storylines, there is a lot to unpack. This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know to master Scarlet and Violet.

Table of Contents

  1. Choosing Your Starter
  2. The Three Storylines
  3. The Terastallize Mechanic
  4. Tera Raids Strategy
  5. Shiny Hunting in Paldea
  6. Best Pokémon to Catch
  7. Post-Game Content
  8. Conclusion

Choosing Your Starter

The first major decision in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet is choosing your starter Pokémon. The three options are Sprigatito (Grass), Fuecoco (Fire), and Quaxly (Water), and each has its strengths and weaknesses. Sprigatito evolves into Meowscarada, a Grass/Dark type with high Speed and Attack. Its signature move, Flower Trick, always lands a critical hit, making it reliable for damage output.

Fuecoco evolves into Skeledirge, a Fire/Ghost type with excellent HP and Special Attack. Its signature move, Torch Song, boosts Special Attack after each use, allowing it to snowball into a powerful sweeper. Skeledirge is widely considered the easiest starter for casual playthroughs due to its bulk and typing.

Quaxly evolves into Quaquaval, a Water/Fighting type with high Attack and Speed. Its signature move, Aqua Step, boosts Speed after each use, allowing it to outspeed increasingly faster opponents. Quaquaval is an excellent choice for players who prefer aggressive, fast-paced playstyles.

The Three Storylines

Pokémon Scarlet and Violet feature three distinct storylines that you can pursue in any order, a first for the franchise. The Victory Road storyline follows the traditional Pokémon journey of defeating eight gym leaders and challenging the Champion. This storyline is familiar to veteran players and provides a structured progression path.

The Starfall Street storyline involves battling Team Star, a group of rebellious students who have set up bases across Paldea. Each Team Star base is led by a different boss with a specific type specialty, and completing these battles earns you rewards and progresses the story. This storyline adds variety to the gameplay and introduces you to characters you might otherwise miss.

The Path of Legends storyline involves finding the mysterious Herba Mystica alongside Arven. Each Herba Mystica is guarded by a Titan Pokémon, which is larger and stronger than normal. Defeating these Titans unlocks new traversal abilities for your legendary ride Pokémon, allowing you to access new areas. This storyline provides essential progression and should not be ignored.

The Terastallize Mechanic

Terastallize is the signature mechanic of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, and understanding it is crucial for success. When a Pokémon Terastallizes, it changes its type to its Tera Type, which can be different from its original typing. This allows for unexpected type matchups and strategic depth.

Each Pokémon has a Tera Type that is determined when it is caught or hatched. Some Pokémon have Tera Types that match their original typing, while others have different Tera Types that can surprise opponents. For example, a Fire-type Pokémon with a Grass Tera Type can Terastallize to resist Water-type moves that would normally be super effective.

Terastallizing also boosts the power of moves that match the Tera Type, and provides Same Type Attack Bonus (STAB) for those moves even if the Pokémon original typing is different. This can turn a weak move into a powerful weapon, or provide defensive coverage that was previously unavailable.

Tera Raids Strategy

Tera Raid Battles are a major feature of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, where you team up with three other players (or AI companions) to battle a powerful Terastallized Pokémon. These raids come in different star ratings, with higher star ratings indicating more difficult Pokémon.

To succeed in Tera Raids, you need to build a team that can deal with the specific Tera Type of the raid boss. A Pokémon with a type advantage against the Tera Type will deal extra damage, while a Pokémon with the same typing as the Tera Type will resist its attacks. Support Pokémon with healing and buffing moves can also be invaluable.

The best strategy for Tera Raids is to bring a Pokémon with high defensive stats and a type advantage. Defensive Pokémon can survive longer and continue dealing damage over time. Offense-focused Pokémon can deal massive damage but may fall quickly to the boss attacks. Balance is key.

Shiny Hunting in Paldea

Shiny hunting in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet is more accessible than ever, thanks to several mechanics that increase shiny odds. The base shiny rate is 1 in 4,096, but with the right methods, you can increase these odds significantly.

The Mass Outbreaks feature is the primary method for shiny hunting. Mass Outbreaks are groups of the same Pokémon species that appear in specific locations. By defeating or catching a certain number of Pokémon in an outbreak, you can increase the shiny odds. After defeating 60 Pokémon in an outbreak, the shiny rate increases to 1 in 1,365.

Using the Shiny Charm, which you receive for completing the Pokédex, further increases the shiny rate to 1 in 683. Combined with Mass Outbreaks, the shiny rate can reach 1 in 512, making shiny hunting much more feasible. The Sandwich system also allows you to boost the appearance rate of specific types, making it easier to find the shiny you want.

Best Pokémon to Catch

Beyond your starter, there are several Pokémon in Paldea that are worth catching and adding to your team. Flutter Mane is a powerful special attacker with excellent Speed and Special Attack. It is a Paradox Pokémon that appears in Area Zero after completing the main story.

Iron Hands is another Paradox Pokémon with incredible physical attack and bulk. Its Fighting/Electric typing provides excellent coverage, and it learns Close Combat and Wild Charge for powerful STAB moves. Iron Hands is widely used in Tera Raids due to its durability and damage output.

Chien-Pao is a legendary Pokémon with the Sword of Ruin ability, which lowers the defense of all Pokémon on the field. This makes it an excellent offensive Pokémon that can deal massive damage. Chien-Pao is a Dark/Ice type with high Speed and Attack.

Other notable Pokémon include Gholdengo, a Steel/Ghost type with excellent special attack and the Good as Gold ability that makes it immune to status moves. Annihilape, the evolution of Primeape, is a Ghost/Fighting type with incredible attack and the Defiant ability. These Pokémon can carry you through the post-game content and competitive battles.

Post-Game Content

After completing the main story, there is plenty of post-game content to enjoy. The Academy Ace Tournament is a challenging tournament that tests your team against powerful trainers from throughout the game. The tournament features unique teams with varied strategies, providing a true test of your skills.

The Area Zero storyline continues after the main game, introducing you to the Paradox Pokémon and the mysteries of the Great Crater of Paldea. This storyline provides some of the most challenging battles in the game and rewards you with rare and powerful Pokémon.

The Indigo Disk DLC adds even more content, including new Pokémon, new areas, and new storylines. If you have the DLC, there is hours of additional gameplay to enjoy. The DLC also introduces new mechanics like Synchro Machine, which allows you to control your Pokémon directly in the overworld.

Conclusion

Pokémon Scarlet and Violet are rich with content and mechanics that provide hundreds of hours of gameplay. Whether you are working through the main story, hunting for shinies, or challenging Tera Raids, there is always something to do. The open-world design gives you unprecedented freedom to explore and tackle challenges in any order you choose.

Remember to use our random Pokémon generator to add some randomness to your Paldea adventure, and check our shiny Pokémon checker to see all the shiny forms available in the game. The Paldea region is vast and full of surprises — enjoy your journey!
